whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Shiva Yoga,

I noticed your yoga studio has an outstanding 4.9★ rating in Kankarbagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new class bookings and trial inquiries.

Maine aapke yoga studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, class batch timings, aur student testimonials integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://shivayoga.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Shiva Yoga team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for your classes in Ashok Nagar. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
